messages:
Samir (partnerships): Heads-up: AWS marketplace requested pen-test evidence AND a signed attestation for hardware HSM integration on our dedicated offering. They want the attestation in a specific JSON metadata bundle. Deadline next Wednesday.
Leah (security): I can draft the attestation text. Confirming scope: HSM firmware hashes, HSM provisioning audit trail, and SOC2 control references?
Hiro (cloud): For ingestion I need artifact names, checksums, presigned URLs. Also HSM-related artifacts might be large (binary firmware). Use multipart presign for anything >50MB.
Cam (SI): We'll coordinate the SI witness for the HSM interface tests. Need to know whether marketplace wants remote witness or onsite.
Pri (sales): Marketplace rep said remote witness is acceptable. They need a short executive summary for customers on the listing page. Can we provide a 2-3 sentence safety blurb?
marketplace-bot: Ingestion schema: required metadata fields: partner_name, listing_id, artifact_types, evidence_ts, contact_email, checksum_sha256. For attestations include attest_type: "security-hardware-hsm". See docs: https://marketplace.docs/hardware.
Samir (partnerships): Leah, can you make the attestation JSON conform to their schema? Also we need a chain-of-custody note for firmware delivery.
Leah (security): sure. I'll produce attestation JSON + human-readable memo. Will include an HSM firmware hash list and a signed timestamp. Note: legal needs to sign off on releasing firmware hashes publicly.
Hiro (cloud): I'll create S3 path partners/hsm-integration/2078901234/ and presign links. Will also include metadata.json with checksums.
Cam (SI): For the witness, propose a 60-minute remote session: 20m scope overview, 30m targeted tests, 10m Q&A. Available Mon/Tue next week.
Pri (sales): I'll sync with marketplace PM and request Tue afternoon PT if possible. Also will coordinate the 2-3 sentence blurb with marketing.
Leah (security): Legal flag on firmware hashes echoed. Rina (legal) can we release hashes in the public listing?
marketplace-bot: Reminder: if artifacts include PII or customer data, the ingestion will be rejected. Use redaction and list removed fields in redaction_map.txt.
Samir (partnerships): okay cross-team plan: Leah -> attestation JSON + memo (due in 48h), Hiro -> presign path + metadata (after legal clears firmware hashes), Cam -> witness runbook + schedule, Pri -> PM & marketing copy.
Hiro (cloud): noted. Also suggest storing signed attest.json and attest.txt in gated bucket and only publish attestation JSON in marketplace.
Leah (security): will prepare both public attestation JSON and gated internal attest.txt (full details).
Cam (SI): will produce a short checklist of HSM tests (PIN injection, key import/export restrictions, firmware verification).
Pri (sales): marketplace PM confirmed Tue 2pm PT works if artifacts are uploaded by Monday EOD. I'll push partner for faster turnaround.
Samir (partnerships): great. Please paste presigned links here when ready. Also include metadata JSON and a one-line summary for the marketplace listing.
Leah (security): one-line: "Redwood Inference: HSM-backed key management for private deployments with verified firmware and audited provisioning." Will refine with marketing.
Hiro (cloud): will handle checksum generation and multipart presign if needed. ETA for presigns: Monday AM.
Cam (SI): will share runbook and confirm Tue 2pm if partner agrees.
Pri (sales): partner ops is looped. We'll aim for Monday artifact delivery.
Samir (partnerships): thanks team. Keep this thread updated. Remember: no secrets in channel. :lock:
